answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 60257 Country: India Title: Timing for reading the Quranpak. Question: Can we read the holy Quran between Asr and Maghrib timing? Somebody passed a message to me that we cannot read the Quran between Asr and Maghrib timing. Is it correct? Please inform as early as possible. Answer ID: 60257 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1153/1172/L=09/1436) Yes, you may recite the holy Quran between Asr and Maghrib. The text of the message is not correct. You did better that you enquired about it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
